intro.title: Your range
intro.text: Your Casio runs from C2 to C7. A full piano has 88 keys, from A0 to C8, so some music goes past your ends.

intro.title: The fix
intro.text: 1. Find the notes that don't fit. 2. Move the whole phrase an octave, not one note, so the tune keeps its shape. 3. Check the hands don't collide.

intro.title: This piece
intro.text: It was written for 88 keys: bars 5–6 went up to C8 and the last bass note was C1. Here bars 5–6 are an octave lower and the bass is an octave higher.
